messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (rwd-small, us-west-2) — error rate 18% over 5m. paging jamie_oncall, nina_sre, maya_eng :rotating_light:

jamie_oncall: seeing it. Affected customers: a few high-volume tenants, some dedicated pools. I’m jumping in.

maya_eng: on it — looks like KV cache growth on hosts gw-3/4, OOMs causing inference workers to restart. grabbing logs.

nina_sre: are we seeing autoscale spin-up? might be throttling from the new batching config. tagging ops-bot to check recent deploys.

ops-bot: deploybot: deploy 2026-06-12T02:14 by maya_eng to inferencer cluster us-west-2 succeeded.

maya_eng: yep that deploy changed batcher defaults (max_batch_size=512). rolling it back now to max_batch_size=256.

jamie_oncall: rollback command: ``kubectl -n inference set image deployment/batcher batcher=image:v2.3.1`` — doing a canary on gw-1 first.

liam_support: flagging customers A123 and B456 — both opened tickets citing high latency and failures. CCing account owners.

maya_eng: canary looks healthy for 3 minutes, error rate down to 2.1% on gw-1. starting progressive rollout.

incident-bot: incident severity set to P1 by jamie_oncall — incident channel created.

jamie_oncall: mitigation in place, errors dropping. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. can we schedule a postmortem + SLA/billing sync tomorrow?

nina_sre: agree. propose postmortem at 2026-06-13 16:00 UTC. add oncall handoff at 16:30.

ops-bot: paging handoff reminder scheduled for 2026-06-13T16:30Z to jamie_oncall -> nina_sre.

maya_eng: root cause preliminary: the batcher default change increased memory churn leading to KV cache eviction thrashing on older GPU hosts; under concurrent workloads that triggered worker restarts. regression introduced in v2.3.2.

jamie_oncall: action items to track: 1) rollback batcher defaults (done) 2) add canary policy to batcher config 3) add memory headroom check to autoscaler 4) identify customers impacted + compute SLA exposure. assigning owners below.

maya_eng: taking item 2 and 3. ETA EOD tomorrow for config PRs.

nina_sre: I’ll own item 4 (customer impact list + uptime delta). will produce spreadsheet with per-tenant error minutes and estimated SLA credit.

liam_support: I’ll draft customer comms once we have impact numbers. want to align on wording with tara_product.

tara_product: agree. Include apology, summary of mitigation, planned remediation, and any credits. Keep it short.

ana_finance_placeholder: 

ana_finance_placeholder: [placeholder removed]

ana_finance: moving in — please tag me when you have the per-tenant minutes. finance will need the time windows, invoice IDs, and customer billing contacts to process credits.

jamie_oncall: nina_sre will push preliminary impact by 12:00 UTC tomorrow. nina — can you include a ballpark $$ impact for top 3 customers so we can pre-approve credits?

nina_sre: yes. will estimate token minutes and use the contracted SLA formula. quick note on method: we compute customer downtime minutes as sum of requests with 5xx or >5s latencies while error rate >5% for that tenant. will link the query in the doc.

maya_eng: quick log snippet from gw-3 before restart:
```
2026-06-12T02:16:04.123Z batcher: mem=14.9GB/16GB cache_evictions=432 interval=60s
2026-06-12T02:16:05.987Z worker[pid=1123]: OOM killer invoked
2026-06-12T02:16:06.004Z worker[pid=1123]: restart
```

jamie_oncall: good evidence. nina, mark nodes with that signature as suspect so infra can prioritize repros on non-prod.

nina_sre: done. I'll also add a column for "likely avoidable via config" vs "infrastructure upgrade required".

liam_support: FYI customers A123/B456 expect an update within 24h. I’ll hold off sending anything until we have the numbers and the draft message.

tara_product: once nina posts numbers, i'll review tone. If top-customer credit estimate >$5k, we should loop in sales for approval.

ana_finance: FYI finance process: small credits (<$10k) can be processed via billing team; larger ones require VPM approval and a journal entry. estimate time-to-apply is 3-5 business days after approval.

maya_eng: planning follow-ups: 1) backport fix to older batcher images 2) add CI test for memory churn under load 3) telemetry dashboard for batcher memory and eviction rate.

ops-bot: meeting created: "Postmortem: batcher memory churn — 2026-06-13 16:00 UTC" — invite sent to participants. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/pm-1862001234

jamie_oncall: posting quick timeline to the doc now. nina, can you add the tenant-level minute counts there so I can validate?

nina_sre: uploaded spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/spreadsheets/incident-1862001234 — sheet tabs: timeline, tenant-impacts, sla-estimates. top three tenant estimated credits: A123=$3,200; B456=$1,150; C789=$0 (below SLA threshold). total preliminary estimate = $4,350.

ana_finance: received. please also include invoice IDs and contract billing cycles for A123/B456/C789. I’ll queue a billing adjustment draft.

liam_support: drafted customer note in the doc under comms-draft. pinged tara_product for review.

tara_product: edited the tone, added a short FAQ. I recommend offering A123 immediate credit and mention we’ll follow up with formal adjustment within 5 business days.

jamie_oncall: assigning tasks in the thread:
- maya_eng: backport fix & CI tests (due 2026-06-14)
- nina_sre: final tenant minutes + formal SLA calc (due 2026-06-13 12:00 UTC)
- liam_support: send holding note to customers within 24h after nina's numbers (due 2026-06-13 18:00 UTC)
- ana_finance: prepare billing adjustment paperwork once invoice IDs provided (due 2026-06-14)

ana_finance: noted. I’ll create a billing_adjustments ticket and tag accounting.

maya_eng: quick question — should we also open a Dedicated-hosting exception ticket for affected tenants if they request priority remediation?

tara_product: yes, escalate on request. sales should own customer comms if escalation happens.

nina_sre: final report uploaded to incident tracker: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1862001234/postmortem — includes RCA, timeline, and metrics.

ops-bot: handoff reminder: nina_sre oncall -> jamie_oncall off at 2026-06-13T16:30Z (completed).

jamie_oncall: closing incident channel. monitoring degraded but stable. follow-ups tracked in postmortem doc. thanks everyone for quick work. :trophy:

liam_support: will update customers after finance confirms credits.

ana_finance: created ticket BA-8742 (billing adj) and assigned to accounting team. reference incident 1862001234. ETA to apply credits 2026-06-17.

tara_product: adding postmortem action items to our roadmap sprint.

incident-bot: Incident 1862001234 marked resolved by jamie_oncall at 2026-06-12T04:05:12Z.

nina_sre: follow-up note — we recommend a default max_batch_size cap in product configs until we complete memory-leak-proofing work.

maya_eng: will draft config PR tonight and link to the postmortem.

liam_support: closing loop with customers once credits are posted and we'll confirm via support tickets.

ana_finance: will post final accounting note when credits applied.

jamie_oncall: thanks team. ending thread.
